entries.Original: Open Sentinel Hunts. Subcommands: test, stop, retry, skip.
Sentinel Hunts has its own assembly, command, configuration, queue, and internal name. It can be installed beside S Rank Sentinel without replacing it.
entries.Translated: Sentinel Hunts 拥有独立的程序集、命令、配置、队列和内部名称。它可以与 S Rank Sentinel 并存安装，而不会将其替换。
